recipes.label: An Old Wolf's Ending
recipes.startdescription: I walk out into the snows alone, and find the Iron-Eater laying beneath a tree. His horse waits nearby, quietly. He does not stir when I approach - but then his voice crackles to life from within him. 'What I wouldn't give just to pull the skin from your flesh with my bare hands,' he whispers. 'But I am weary. So weary.' His voice is like broken glass. 'I was going to help you,' the Long spits. 'Well, what's it matter now, I suppose. Come here. Finish the job.'
recipes.description: I finish off the Iron-Eater in silence. So ends the last of the Black Hundred, my Elder in Hate, and a fellow Wolf.
